units.source_text: 已经是只有他自己才能听到的微弱悲鸣了。

en.t: It had already become a faint cry that only he himself could hear.

units.source_text: 男人浑身颤抖着弯下腰，摸索着收拾起砸坏了的采集箱。

en.t: The man bent over, trembling all over, and groped around as he gathered up the smashed collecting box.

units.source_text: 装酒精的容器上好像有了裂缝，碰到手上冰凉凉的，那感觉啪地在手指间扩散开来。

en.t: The container holding the alcohol seemed to have cracked; when it touched his hand it was icy cold, and the sensation spread sharply between his fingers.

units.source_text: 男人压低声音啜泣起来。

en.t: The man began to sob in a suppressed voice.

units.source_text: 他感到简直像别人在哭泣似的。

en.t: It felt to him almost as if someone else were crying.
